_comment: MANUAL ALLOWLIST — the only sanctioned way to publish about a player who is confirmed signed/registered but has not yet appeared in the live FPL bootstrap feed (there is normally a 1-2 day lag after a real transfer). This file is NOT a place to add names the bot got wrong; it is a place a human vouches for a player with first-party evidence. Every entry needs name, club, evidence_url and expires_at. An entry with any of those missing is IGNORED. An entry past expires_at is IGNORED, so this file cannot rot into a stale source of truth — it either gets renewed on purpose or the FPL feed takes over. Keep expiries short (2-4 weeks).

_entry_schema.name: Full name as the club announced it
_entry_schema.evidence_url: First-party announcement URL (club site / Premier League)
